text.p: Melita International Corp said Thursday it has set an initial public offering of 3.5 million shares of its common stock at a price of $10.00 per share.
All of the 3,500,000 shares were offered by the company. Montgomery Securities and Robertson, Stephens & Company are the managing underwriters of the offering.
The company has granted to the underwriters an option to purchase up to 525,000 additional shares for the purpose of covering over-allotments, if any.

Melita said it expects to use the net proceeds from this offering to pay previously undistributed earnings, for working capital and for other general corporate purposes which may include possible acquisitions of, or investments in, businesses or technologies.
Melita provides customer contact and call management systems.
